statements.sql: UPDATE workspace.docs_rag_dev.silver_chunks SET embed_text = left(embed_text, length(embed_text) - 11) WHERE config_id = 'ccbd80f05e15c8dd' AND version_tag = 'v4.0.1' AND path = 'docs/index.md' AND chunk_index = 0 AND endswith(embed_text, ' [tampered]')

SELECT chunk_id, sha2(embed_text, 256) AS embed_sha256, length(embed_text) AS chars FROM workspace.docs_rag_dev.silver_chunks WHERE config_id = 'ccbd80f05e15c8dd' AND version_tag = 'v4.0.1' AND path = 'docs/index.md' AND chunk_index = 0
